blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David has warned that technological and economic development must not come at the expense of people and the environment, expressing concern over the Philippines’ participation in the US-led Pax Silica initiative. He cited the initiative’s possible implications for Indigenous peoples and their ancestral domains, the country’s natural resources, and national sovereignty. READ: Pax Silica brings promise – but at what cost? “The controversy surrounding Pax Silica … raises important ethical questions that deserve serious public discussion,” David said.
